notes:
桌面端渲染器退回 Skia，修复 Intel Mac 花屏。

## 修复

- **Intel Mac 花屏**（影响 v1.3.28 起的所有 macOS 版本）：Flutter 3.47 起 macOS
  默认切换到 Impeller 渲染器，YueLink 自 v1.3.28 的工具链升级起跟着切了过去。
  Intel Mac 的 GPU（AMD Radeon / Intel Iris）正是上游多次报告 Impeller 崩溃与
  画面损坏的硬件，有用户在 macOS 26.4.1 上出现整窗花屏。本版把 macOS 钉回
  此前所有版本一直使用的 Skia 渲染器。通用二进制只有一份 Info.plist，因而
  Apple Silicon 同样退回 Skia——那正是 v1.3.27 及之前全部版本的状态。
- **Windows / Linux 同类风险一并处理**：同一次 Flutter 升级也把这两个平台默认切到了
  Impeller。Windows 上 Impeller 明确拒绝软件渲染回退，远程桌面、虚拟机、
  只有基础显卡驱动的机器以前能「慢但可用」，切换后会直接得到一个空窗口；
  Linux 显卡驱动最杂。两端一并钉回 Skia。
- 三处开关各有守卫测试锁定，避免被工具重生成或后续升级悄悄抹掉。

## 兼容性

账号、订阅、协议、更新签名公钥、各平台升级身份均未改变。
内核基线 mihomo v1.19.30。Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2。

## 说明

Flutter 已声明未来版本将移除 Impeller 退出开关；届时需重新评估。
移动端不受影响：iOS 早已只有 Impeller，Android 未改动。

**v1.3.36 从未发布**：其构建全绿、候选包已上架，但 promote 第一次在本机运行时被中断，留下的不可变绑定记录让第二次 promote 无法完成，根清单未切换，没有产出可安装的更新。本版包含它的全部内容。
notesEn:
Desktop renderer pinned back to Skia; fixes garbled rendering on Intel Macs.

## Fixed

- **Garbled rendering on Intel Macs** (affects every macOS build since
  v1.3.28): Flutter 3.47 switched macOS to the Impeller renderer by default,
  and YueLink inherited that with the toolchain bump that shipped in v1.3.28.
  Intel Mac GPUs (AMD Radeon / Intel Iris) are exactly where upstream keeps
  collecting Impeller crash and corrupted-frame reports, and a user on
  macOS 26.4.1 saw the whole window corrupt. This release pins macOS back to
  the Skia renderer every earlier version used. A universal bundle has one
  Info.plist, so Apple Silicon returns to Skia as well — the state of every
  release up to v1.3.27.
- **Windows and Linux handled at the same time**: the same Flutter upgrade
  flipped both platforms to Impeller. On Windows, Impeller explicitly refuses
  the software-rendering fallback, so Remote Desktop sessions, VMs and
  machines on a basic display driver would go from "slow but working" to a
  blank window; Linux has the most heterogeneous GPU drivers. Both are pinned
  back to Skia.
- Each of the three switches is locked by a guard test so a tool regeneration
  or a later upgrade cannot silently drop it.

## Compatibility

Accounts, subscriptions, protocols, update-signing keys, and per-platform
upgrade identities are unchanged. Core baseline mihomo v1.19.30.
Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2.

## Note

Flutter has announced that a future release removes the Impeller opt-out; this
decision will need revisiting then. Mobile is unaffected: iOS has been
Impeller-only for a long time, and Android is unchanged.

**v1.3.36 was never published**: its build was green and the candidate was staged, but the first promote run (on a workstation) was interrupted and the immutable binding record it left behind blocked the second promote, so the root manifest was never switched and no installable update was produced. This release contains everything that was in it.
